title: A Letter from London
text:
Hi Anna, thanks for your email! I am happy to hear from you. I am in London now. The weather is cold and rainy, but the city is great. I visit museums every day.

Next week I am free on Monday. Can we meet for lunch? There is a nice cafe near my hotel. Please write back soon. Love, Tom.

questions.text: Which day is Tom free next week?
How does Tom feel about Anna's email?
options: He is happy to hear from her

questions.text: Why does Tom want to meet for lunch?
options: He wants to buy a hotel
He wants to go to work
He wants to see her and talk

vocabulary.definition: the conditions outside, such as rain, sun or cold
buildings where people can look at art or old objects
a small place where you can buy drinks and simple food
a place where you pay to stay for a few nights

paragraph_translations: Привіт, Анна, дякую за твій лист! Я радий отримати від тебе звістку. Зараз я в Лондоні. Погода холодна й дощова, але місто чудове. Щодня я відвідую музеї.
Наступного тижня я вільний у понеділок. Чи можемо ми зустрітися на обід? Поруч із моїм готелем є гарне кафе. Будь ласка, напиши мені незабаром. З любов'ю, Том.
